catalyst.notes: ML sources agree on Pd(PPh3)4, but Rule source prefers Pd2(dba)3/SPhos and Protocol has no catalyst

solvent.notes: ML: dioxane/DMF/MeOH (disagree), Rule: THF/H2O, Protocol: tert-amyl alcohol

temperature.notes: Only Rule source specifies temperature (45-60°C), others unspecified

base.notes: 2/3 ML sources + Rule source use K2CO3, Protocol uses K3PO4

synthesis.confidence_reasoning: Medium confidence due to base agreement across sources but significant divergence in catalyst/solvent recommendations. ML similarity scores are very low (0.01), but Rule source provides substrate-specific guidance.

recommended_condition.rationale: Rule source provides specific guidance for Suzuki coupling with heteroaryl boronate (2-furylboronate). SPhos ligand recommended for electron-rich/heteroaryl systems. THF/H2O biphasic system facilitates base solubility while maintaining organoboron stability. Temperature from Rule source optimized for conversion.

backup_conditions.when_to_use: <30% conv after 6h: try traditional Pd(PPh3)4 in dioxane with higher temp
<20% conv after 12h: switch to more active Pd/XPhos system with stronger base

warnings: 2-Furylboronate may be sensitive to protodeboronation - monitor reaction progress
Heteroaryl systems can coordinate Pd differently - SPhos/XPhos recommended
Aqueous base necessary but minimize water content with boronate ester
No nitro groups present so no reduction risk

source_comparison.ml_contribution: Provided multiple Pd(PPh3)4 conditions but with low confidence scores
source_comparison.rule_contribution: Key guidance for heteroaryl boronate system with Pd2(dba)3/SPhos
source_comparison.protocol_contribution: Alternative solvent (tert-amyl alcohol) and base (K3PO4) options
